top_signals.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
top_signals.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
top_signals.summary: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Moody's holds steady on France's credit rating as country grapples with turmoil and higher yields
top_signals.summary: Moody's left its credit rating on France at Aa3, giving the country some relief in a week of unrest.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Andrew Brandt on MLB Salary Cap Fight as World Series Begins
top_signals.summary: Andrew Brandt says the Brewers and Rays reaching the World Series—despite ranking 19th and 26th in payroll, respectively—shows how strong management, scouting and player development can compete with high spending. He calls the matchup evidence for the players’ union that success is possible without a salary cap, while cautioning that owners may dismiss it as an unsustainable exception: smaller-market teams have little margin for error and can lose players to wealthier clubs in free agency. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Corporate report: Government response to Small Business Regulatory Taskforce report
top_signals.summary: Following the Small Business Taskforce's conclusion, the taskforce published a report. The government have now responded to the recommendations.

top_signals.title: New York seeks over $1.3 billion from NovaTech founders after couple fled the US
top_signals.summary: New York wants $1.3 billion from NovaTech's founders, whose platform took in $1.16 billion and traded a fraction of it.
